description: This file is a PHP source code for the 'Theme' controller within the Opencart admin panel, handling CRUD operations, listing, enabling/disabling, and rendering of themes.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Controller class for managing themes in the Opencart admin interface, supporting CRUD operations, listing, enabling/disabling, and template rendering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the theme list page, setting up the page title, breadcrumbs, filters, and including sub-components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Wrapper method to load the theme list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Handles data retrieval for themes, applying filters, pagination, and returning the theme list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a theme, loading existing theme data if available, and populating options.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Loads a Twig template file content via AJAX, returning JSON with the template code.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving or updating a theme, validates permissions and file existence, and responds with JSON.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected themes by setting their status to active if user has permission.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected themes by setting their status to inactive if user has permission.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected themes from the database, validating permissions.
